{{Top|leg}}
The '''CompForce Demnadi Relief Operation''' was a deployment of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demnadi]] after [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Cathers]] requested assistance dealing with a planetary riot. The Demnandi Relief Operation was commanded by [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Fenris Sarhl]], who was also the only member of the force.
